title: AgroData Cloud
one_liner: A cloud platform that turns satellite, drone, and IoT data into actionable insights for Brazilian farms
problem: Farmers lack real‑time, data‑driven decision tools to optimize yields and reduce inputs
why_now: Satellite imagery costs have dropped, IoT sensors are more affordable, and AI analytics are maturing
solution_sketch: Integrate satellite feeds, drone captures, and field sensors into a unified dashboard that uses AI to predict pest outbreaks, irrigation needs, and optimal harvest windows
business_model_hint: Monthly subscription + revenue share on data marketplace sales
assumptions: Farmers are willing to pay for predictive insights
Data providers can supply high‑resolution imagery

title: EduFlex Microlearning
one_liner: An AI‑driven microlearning platform that delivers bite‑size, adaptive courses to mid‑career professionals
problem: Adult learners need flexible, time‑efficient training that fits into busy schedules
audience: Mid‑career professionals and corporate HR teams
why_now: Remote work has increased skill gaps and demand for continuous learning
solution_sketch: Adaptive algorithm curates short modules, gamifies progress, and integrates with existing LMS
business_model_hint: B2B subscription with tiered access and analytics

title: HealthLink Tele‑Pharmacy
one_liner: A tele‑pharmacy network that delivers prescriptions to rural homes via micro‑fulfillment hubs
problem: Rural patients face long travel times and limited pharmacy access
audience: Rural residents and local health centers
why_now: Telehealth adoption accelerated by COVID, and logistics tech is maturing
solution_sketch: Mobile app for prescription requests, AI triage, and local hubs that store and dispense medications
business_model_hint: Commission on each prescription plus subscription for premium services

title: EcoPack
one_liner: Biodegradable packaging made from cassava peels that replaces conventional plastics in the food sector
problem: Plastic waste is a major environmental and regulatory challenge in Brazil
why_now: Regulatory push against single‑use plastics and rising consumer demand for sustainable packaging
solution_sketch: Process cassava peels into film and containers, certify biodegradability, and offer design services
business_model_hint: B2B sales + licensing of proprietary process
assumptions: Manufacturers can meet quality standards with biodegradable material
